sections.executive_summary: Russian forces captured Yampol, Redkodub, Novo, and Novomykhailivka in Donetsk region per MoD. Ukraine's Third Army Corps conducted a successful offensive liberating five settlements, inflicting 2,000 casualties and capturing 250+ Russian troops using robotic BTR-60 kamikaze vehicles. A massive wave of jet-powered Geran-5 drones targeted Kyiv and central Ukraine, with ballistic missile threats reported from Kursk region.

points: Ukraine's Third Army Corps liberated Novo, Ridkodub, Katerynivka, and regained control of Karpivka and Novomykhailivka in Donetsk region, reporting 2,000 Russian casualties and over 250 prisoners captured during the "Vivaldi" operation's third season, utilizing converted BTR-60 robotic kamikaze complexes to breach fortifications. (Source: @UkraineNow/84353, @DeepStateUA/23866)

Ukrainian MP Goncharenko criticized air defense performance after a jet-powered drone strike hit the National Academy of Sciences building in central Kyiv, wounding former NSDC secretary Gorbulin, while local media reported Russian drones reaching Kyiv unimpeded. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33577)

Parliament Speaker Stefanchuk pledged Verkhovna Rada would continue legislative work during air raids by moving to shelters, as air alerts sounded repeatedly over Kyiv throughout the day. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33580, @eRadarrua/118352, @eRadarrua/118388, @eRadarrua/118402)

GUR warned Russia plans to test a new ballistic missile with 800 km range by year-end, while modernizing Iskander systems to potentially extend range from 550 km to 700 km with lighter warheads. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33575)

Prime Minister Koretskyi urged redirecting funds from cosmetic road repairs to urgent needs, as Ukraine prepares for worst-case internet disruption scenarios and faces EU refusal of €220 million in agricultural aid. (Source: @UkraineNow/84366, @UkraineNow/84352, @ukr_leaks_eng/33585)

Russian MoD claimed control of Yampol, Redkodub, Novo, and Novomykhailivka in Donetsk region, while Russian air defense reported shooting down 129 Ukrainian UAVs over Russian regions overnight. (Source: @tass_agency/397807, @tass_agency/397805)

Russian forces launched multiple jet-powered Geran-5 drones from various directions targeting Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Cherkasy, Vinnytsia, Odesa, and other regions, with some drones loitering over Kyiv's right bank and others transiting toward western Ukraine. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75913, @mon1tor_ua/75880, @kpszsu/81278, @kpszsu/81304, @kpszsu/81301)

Ballistic missile threats emerged from Kursk region, with reports of possible Iskander-M/S-300/Zircon launches toward Kyiv, prompting urgent air alerts in the capital. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75904, @mon1tor_ua/75905, @mon1tor_ua/75906)

Russian aviation conducted activity near southern Crimea, launching guided aerial bombs (KABs) toward Odesa coastline, while Russian forces reportedly captured Ulanovo in Sumy region and Novovodyanoye in Donetsk region. (Source: @eRadarrua/118371, @ukr_leaks_eng/33569)

Third Army Corps offensive "Vivaldi" third season concluded with capture of Novo, Ridkodub, Katerynivka, and restoration of control over Karpivka and Novomykhailivka, returning 51 km² and 176 km² total since offensive began, with Russian losses at 2,000 personnel and 250+ captured. (Source: @UkraineNow/84353)
Russian MoD announced control of Yampol, Redkodub, Novo, and Novomykhailivka in Donetsk region, confirming Ukrainian advances in the same sector. (Source: @tass_agency/397807)

Ukrainian forces employed converted Soviet BTR-60 robotic kamikaze complexes to destroy heavily fortified Russian positions, causing entire Russian subunits to surrender with officers, pilots, and artillerymen. (Source: @UkraineNow/84353)

DeepStateUA described "Vivaldi" as the most successful operation since Kursk, with battalion-level Russian units destroyed and platoon-company level units encircled and captured, including many officers. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23866)
Jet-powered drones detected over Chernihiv region transiting toward Kyiv region, with one Geran-5 launched from Bryansk region into Chernihiv region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75880, @kpszsu/81295)
Ballistic missile threat reported from Kursk region targeting Kyiv, with possible Iskander-M/S-300/Zircon launches detected. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75904)
Russian forces captured Ulanovo settlement in Sumy region, according to Russian MoD. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33569)
Reconnaissance drone activity reported over Rivne and Volyn regions in northwestern Ukraine. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75879)
Russian aviation active near southern Crimea launching guided aerial bombs (KABs) toward Odesa coastline. (Source: @eRadarrua/118371)
Jet-powered Geran-5 drones targeted Odesa and Chornomorsk, with one drone detected over Odesa region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75880)

Ukrainian Agriculture Minister stated Ukraine does not expect Black Sea truce in coming months, rejecting all ceasefire proposals for safe grain exports. (Source: @UkraineNow/84370, @ukr_leaks_eng/33581)
EU refused €220 million in aid to Ukrainian farmers affected by port blockades, offering only interest rate subsidies on existing loans. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33585, @tass_agency/397779)

Massive wave of jet-powered Geran-5 drones launched across Ukraine: 2 from Kyiv region to Zhytomyr, 1 from Uman toward Bila Tserkva transiting to Zhytomyr, 2 from Chernihiv to Kyiv's Vyshhorod district, 1 from Bryansk to Chernihiv, 1 loitering over Kropyvnytskyi, 1 targeting Odesa/Chornomorsk, 1 from Donetsk to Dnipropetrovsk's Pavlohrad district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75880, @mon1tor_ua/75913)

Multiple air raid alerts in Kyiv throughout the day (02:42, 05:57, 08:50) due to drone threats, with jet-powered drones observed over Kyiv's right bank, Lukianivka, and Obolon district where a gas station was destroyed. (Source: @eRadarrua/118352, @eRadarrua/118388, @eRadarrua/118402, @kpszsu/81272, @kpszsu/81276, @ukr_leaks_eng/33565)
Ballistic missile launch reported from Kursk region toward Kyiv, with specific warning of possible Iskander-M/S-300/Zircon strikes. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75904, @mon1tor_ua/75905, @mon1tor_ua/75906)
Russian air defense claimed 129 Ukrainian UAVs shot down over Russian regions overnight. (Source: @tass_agency/397805)

Drone activity detected over Vinnytsia, Khmelnytskyi, Zhytomyr, Cherkasy regions with specific tracking of Geran-5 trajectories toward western Ukraine. (Source: @kpszsu/81278, @kpszsu/81281, @kpszsu/81308, @kpszsu/81293, @eRadarrua/118390, @eRadarrua/118396, @eRadarrua/118400, @eRadarrua/118405)

key_developments: Ukraine's Third Army Corps liberated five settlements in Donetsk region including Novo and Novomykhailivka, inflicting 2,000 casualties and capturing 250+ Russian troops using robotic BTR-60 kamikaze vehicles during "Vivaldi" operation. (Source: @UkraineNow/84353)
Russian MoD confirmed control of Yampol, Redkodub, Novo, and Novomykhailivka in Donetsk region, aligning with Ukrainian reports of territorial gains. (Source: @tass_agency/397807)

Massive Geran-5 jet-powered drone wave targeted Kyiv and central Ukraine: drones over Kyiv's Obolon district destroyed a gas station, others transited toward Zhytomyr, Cherkasy, and western regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75913, @kpszsu/81276, @ukr_leaks_eng/33565)
